short.en: Exposes Additional Fields plugin values as notification tags for Project
short.es: Expone valores del plugin Campos adicionales como etiquetas de notificacion para Proyecto

long.en:
# Fields Notify
Private internal plugin developed for Omint. Exposes custom fields created with the "Fields" (Additional Fields) plugin as notification tags for the Project itemtype, so they can be used in notification templates (e.g. ##project.objetivosestrategicos##).
No custom database tables. No raw SQL queries: reads the item's already-loaded custom_fields JSON column via the GLPI framework.
